tagline.en: Round the northern tip of Taiwan from Tamsui to Su'ao, its northeast-coast stretch cut in the late 1970s to serve the new port at Su'ao
tagline.zh: 自淡水绕过台湾北端至苏澳，东北角路段于 1970 年代末为配合苏澳新港而开辟

start.en: The Guandu bridge at Zhuwei, Tamsui, New Taipei, shared with Provincial Highway 15
start.zh: 新北市淡水区竹围关渡大桥，与台 15 线同一起点

end.en: Su'ao, Yilan, at the start of the improved Suhua Highway on Provincial Highway 9
end.zh: 宜兰县苏澳镇，衔接台 9 线苏花改起点

en: Provincial Highway 2 follows the coast round the northern end of Taiwan. From Tamsui it runs along the north shore under the Datun volcanoes through Sanzhi, Shimen and Jinshan — the Tamsui–Jinshan and Keelung–Jinshan roads — past Yehliu into Keelung harbour. Beyond Keelung it is the Northern Coast Highway proper: it follows the cliffs of the northeast corner by Bitou, Longdong, Fulong and Cape Sandiao, enters Yilan, and crosses the Lanyang plain to Su'ao.

Although numbered as an east–west road, it runs north–south for much of its length. It is a corridor of scenery more than of traffic: soon after the northeast-coast road opened in 1979 the tourism bureau set up the Northeast Coast scenic area, now the Northeast and Yilan Coast National Scenic Area, and parts of the north shore were included in the North Coast and Guanyinshan National Scenic Area in 2002. Before National Freeway 5 opened it was also one of only two road routes between Taipei and Yilan, with Highway 9.
It has seven branches, more than any other provincial highway. One, Highway 2F, Keelung port's western access road to Freeway 3, is the only provincial highway maintained by the freeway bureau.
zh: 台 2 线沿海岸绕过台湾北端。自淡水起，沿大屯火山群北麓的北海岸经三芝、石门、金山——即淡金公路与基金公路——过野柳入基隆港。基隆以东才是狭义的北部滨海公路：沿东北角的峭壁经鼻头、龙洞、福隆、三貂角进入宜兰，再横过兰阳平原到苏澳。
它虽编为东西向公路，但大半路段实际是南北走向。它更多是一条风景廊道而非交通要道：东北角路段 1979 年通车后不久，观光局即成立东北角海岸风景特定区（今东北角暨宜兰海岸国家风景区）；北海岸部分路段则于 2002 年纳入北海岸及观音山国家风景区。国道 5 号通车以前，它与台 9 线是台北至宜兰间仅有的两条公路通道。
台 2 线共有 7 条支线，为省道之最。其中台 2 己线是基隆港西岸衔接国道 3 号的联外道路，也是全台唯一由高速公路局养护的省道。

en: The north shore has the older roads. According to the Taipei County gazetteer, the Spanish, who landed at Cape Sandiao in 1628, opened a track from Keelung by Jinshan round the north coast to Tamsui, later extended to Yilan and Su'ao; nothing of it survives. Under the Qing the Jinbaoli fish road crossed the Yangming hills from Jinshan to Taipei, and the Caoling trail linked Keelung with the Kavalan plain. The Japanese made the Taipei–Tamsui, Tamsui–Jinshan, Keelung–Jinshan and Yilan–Su'ao roads into motor roads, all 'designated roads' paid for from national or local funds; the coast road under the Datun hills was known as the Datun Village Road.

The northeast corner had no road. When the provincial highways were first numbered after the Highway Act, Highway 2 was only the Taipei–Tamsui road to the Shalun beach. In about 1975 the expansion of Su'ao harbour, one of the Ten Major Construction Projects, needed a land link, and the provincial highway bureau set up a Northern Coast Highway engineering office to build one. A retired Bitou fishermen's association official later told Rhythms Monthly that the first plan, for want of money, would have turned inland by Jiufen to Keelung and missed the coast villages, until he persuaded a provincial assemblyman from Ruifang to have it moved to the shore.

In the 1978 renumbering the new road and the county roads it joined — Shalun to Keelung, Keelung to Ruibin, Aodi to Gongliao, Fulong to the Lanyang River — were all put under Highway 2, which grew from twenty-odd kilometres to more than 170. Because Taipei had become a special municipality, the start was moved to the city boundary at Guandu, and the Taipei section became part of Highway 2A over Yangmingshan. The Keelung–Su'ao road opened to traffic on 10 August 1979, and the highway bureau put on a coast bus to Yilan the same day.

Since then the changes have been at the ends. In 1993 the main line was moved onto the Tamsui bypass and the old road through the town became Highway 2B. In 2011 the end was pushed through Su'ao port to Nanfang'ao, and in 2018 it was moved again so that Highway 2 now ends where the improved Suhua Highway begins.
zh: 北海岸的道路较早。据《台北县志·交通志》，1628 年自三貂角登陆的西班牙人，曾开辟一条自基隆经金山、绕北海岸至淡水的通道，后又向南延伸到宜兰与苏澳，但如今已无遗迹可寻。清代有翻越阳明山区、自金山通往台北的金包里鱼路古道，鸡笼至噶玛兰之间则以草岭古道联络。日人将台北—淡水、淡水—金山、基隆—金山、宜兰—苏澳等路线辟为行车道路，皆属以国库或地方经费改善养护的「指定道路」；大屯山群北麓那段海岸路，曾称为「大屯里街道」。
东北角原本无路。公路法实施后第一次编号时，台 2 线只是台北至淡水沙仑海水浴场的北淡公路。1975 年前后，十大建设之一的苏澳港扩建需要一条联外道路，省公路局遂成立北部滨海公路工程处负责修筑。鼻头角渔会退休主任王金火日后向《经典》回忆，最初的计划因经费所限，道路要经九份转往基隆，不会沿海经过渔村，是他向瑞芳籍省议员李儒侯求助，才把路线改到海边。
1978 年第二次整编时，新辟路线与沿途的县道——沙仑至基隆、基隆至瑞滨、澳底至贡寮、福隆至兰阳溪北岸——全数纳入台 2 线，总长由 20 余公里增加到 170 余公里。又因台北市升格为直辖市，起点改为关渡省市界处，原台北市区路段并入经阳明山的台 2 甲线。基隆至苏澳路段于 1979 年 8 月 10 日开放通车，公路局同日开行经滨海公路往宜兰的班车。
此后的变化都在两端。1993 年主线改经淡水外环道，原穿过市区的旧线改编为台 2 乙线。2011 年终点穿过苏澳港区延长至南方澳；2018 年再度调整，使台 2 线终点正好衔接苏花改起点。

en: The road was built in two phases. The first, from January 1976 to August 1979, ran from the Bisha bridge at Badouzi fishing harbour in Keelung south to Toucheng; only the Ruibin–Fulong section was new road, and the rest was improvement of existing roads. The second, from July 1979 to May 1982, covered two pieces: Sijiaoting, near Badu in Keelung, to Ruibin in the north, and Toucheng to Su'ao in the south, where the old road was widened to four lanes.

The new section was the hard part. At Bitou the cliffs drop almost vertically into the sea and leave almost no flat ground, and the hillsides are hard rock under thin vegetation. A documentary film of the road shot in the autumn of 1979, now held by the Taiwan Film and Audiovisual Institute, picked out three tunnels — Bitou, Binhai and Longdong — as the most difficult works.
zh: 工程分两期办理。第一期 1976 年 1 月开工，1979 年 8 月完工，范围自基隆八斗子渔港碧沙桥南下至头城，其中只有瑞滨至福隆段为新辟路线，其余为改善既有道路。第二期 1979 年 7 月开工，1982 年 5 月完工，分南北两段：北段自基隆八堵四脚亭至瑞滨，南段自头城至苏澳，旧路拓宽为四线道。
新辟路段最为艰巨。鼻头角一带的峭壁几乎垂直削入海中，几无腹地，植被之下都是坚硬岩层。一部 1979 年秋天拍摄、现由国家电影及视听文化中心典藏的纪录片，特别指出鼻头、滨海、龙洞三座隧道是开辟时最艰巨的工程。

en: Limits are 40 to 70 km/h. It is a coast road for leisure: weekend traffic for Yehliu, Jinshan, Fulong beach and the northeast-coast fishing harbours is heavy, and cyclists are common. When the road opened, Fulong was under an hour from Keelung; National Freeway 5 has since taken the through traffic to Yilan, but the transport ministry's museum site notes that Kuo-Kuang buses kept running the coast route, with the view of Turtle Island from Fulong to Wai'ao.
zh: 速限为每小时 40 至 70 公里。这是一条休闲的海岸公路：周末前往野柳、金山、福隆海水浴场与东北角各渔港的车流很大，自行车骑士也多。通车之初，自基隆到福隆不到一小时；国道 5 号通车后，往宜兰的过境车流大多改道，但据交通部博物馆网站，国光客运仍继续派车行驶滨海路线，福隆至外澳一段可远眺龟山岛。

why.en: No published cost was found for the Northern Coast Highway works of 1976–1982, nor for the earlier north-shore roads it absorbed.
why.zh: 未找到 1976—1982 年北部滨海公路工程的公开造价，其所并入的早期北海岸道路亦无。

why.en: The sources say the Taiwan Provincial Highway Bureau built the road, through its Northern Coast Highway engineering office, as the land link for the Su'ao harbour expansion, but not how the work was financed.
why.zh: 资料只说明由台湾省公路局所设的北部滨海公路工程处兴建，作为苏澳港扩建的联外道路，未说明经费来源。

value.en: Phase 1, Badouzi–Toucheng, January 1976 – August 1979; phase 2, Sijiaoting–Ruibin and Toucheng–Su'ao, July 1979 – May 1982
value.zh: 第一期八斗子—头城，1976 年 1 月至 1979 年 8 月；第二期四脚亭—瑞滨及头城—苏澳，1979 年 7 月至 1982 年 5 月

figures.source: Rhythms Monthly (經典雜誌), 【台灣之路】見證台灣發展 山海台二線, by 陳世慧

value.en: From twenty-odd kilometres to more than 170 km
value.zh: 由 20 余公里增至 170 余公里

timeline.en: The Spanish land at Cape Sandiao and later open a track round the north coast to Tamsui.
timeline.zh: 西班牙人自三貂角登陆，其后开辟绕北海岸至淡水的通道。

timeline.en: Work on the Northern Coast Highway starts in January.
timeline.zh: 1 月，北部滨海公路第一期工程开工。

timeline.en: Renumbering puts the coast roads under Highway 2 and moves its start to Guandu.
timeline.zh: 公路整编将沿海道路纳入台 2 线，起点改至关渡。

timeline.en: The Keelung–Su'ao road opens on 10 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 10 日，基隆至苏澳路段开放通车。

timeline.en: The second phase, Sijiaoting–Ruibin and Toucheng–Su'ao, is finished in May.
timeline.zh: 5 月，第二期四脚亭—瑞滨及头城—苏澳工程完工。

timeline.en: The main line moves to the Tamsui bypass; the old town road becomes 2B.
timeline.zh: 主线改经淡水外环道，旧线改为台 2 乙线。

timeline.en: Highway 2F, Keelung port's western access road, opens.
timeline.zh: 基隆港西岸联外道路台 2 己线通车。

timeline.en: The Executive Yuan extends the end through Su'ao port to Nanfang'ao on 14 January.
timeline.zh: 1 月 14 日，行政院公告终点经苏澳港区延长至南方澳。

timeline.en: The end is moved to meet the improved Suhua Highway.
timeline.zh: 终点调整为衔接苏花改起点。
